title: the Crescent Cove Rising
author: August Lockridge
blurb: Sebastian Sterling, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
